chapters.title: Recorded, Not by Choice
chapters.blurb: Replay Chrome is required, not optional — every agent-browser launch runs a gate check before a single page loads.

chapters.title: What the Tape Is Made Of
chapters.blurb: Every open, snapshot, click, and fill throws an event onto a tape as the agent works, automatically.

chapters.title: The Retry Loop at Close
chapters.blurb: Closing the browser triggers a retry loop that classifies the recording and uploads it once it is ready.

chapters.title: A Witness You Can Just Watch
chapters.blurb: A second, local recording — agent-browser record — makes a witness you can just watch, no cloud required.
